title: Quant-sandbox fingerprinting + stochastic canary flow for perf regression detection
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a repeatable onboarding flow that creates a deterministic performance fingerprint for each incoming quantization profile (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) and exercises a stochastic, low-risk canary path in production to catch regressions that matter for customer SLOs.

Motivation: Existing intake pipelines validate accuracy/quality and basic throughput, but we still see intermittent tail-latency and cost regressions after promoting a quant variant. This ticket scopes a quant-sandbox + fingerprint generator that: (1) produces a compact performance fingerprint artifact for each profile; (2) publishes that artifact to the model catalog and pins metadata; (3) powers a staged stochastic canary that runs a small percentage of production traffic against the new variant while tracking walleted metrics (cost-per-token, QPS, P50/P90/P99/P99.9 latency, GPU memory, throughput-per-watt).

Non-goals: Full rollout automation, user-visible fallback UX, or re-training quantization. This is focused on profile-level validation and observable gating for promotion/pinning.

High-level plan: 
- Ingestion: Accept profile bundle (weights patch, op-map, quant-metadata) via the quant-intake API.
- Sandbox run: Execute the profile in an isolated sandbox using a seeded "golden prompt" basket + a stochastic trace generator seeded from recent anonymized production prompts. Collect token-level telemetry including KV cache hit ratios for prefix-heavy prompts.
- Fingerprint: Compute compact fingerprint metrics (latency histogram buckets, normalized token-cost delta vs baseline, rank stability on reranking probes, sample-specific quality deltas). Persist fingerprint as an artifact (signed) and attach to model metadata in the catalog.
- Decisioning: Automatic soft-gate rules: if any of the gating metrics exceed thresholds (e.g., cost delta > 20% vs baseline, P99.9 latency regression > 15% absolute, rank-stability drop > 3 points) block auto-promotion and open a manual review.
- Stochastic canary: For variants that pass sandbox, promote to a 0.5% production sample routed by request hashing. Canary telemetry is folded into the global regression detector with weighted aggregation to amplify tail signals without impacting most users.
- Alerts & Rollback: Define alert thresholds that surface in Slack + Console dashboard (alerts link). If canary triggers a regression, automatically rollback routing and create ENG ticket with fingerprint and diffs.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Automated sandbox ingest + fingerprint artifact is produced for INT8, FP8, GPTQ and AWQ payloads with no schema errors.
- Fingerprint artifact schema documented and stored in S3/catalog.
- Canary routing configured and can be enabled/disabled via console toggle.
- Canary telemetry appears in the quant-regressions dashboard and triggers synthetic alert (test canary) when thresholds intentionally exceeded.
- A demo run (PR sandbox) shows a detected P99.9 regression and an automated rollback sequence.

Security & privacy notes: Sandbox traces derived from sampled, anonymized user prompts with strict PII stripping. Artifacts are signed and stored with KMS encryption as per Private deployment guidelines.

References and artifacts: 
- Confluence design: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/QuantSandbox+Design+Doc 
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3456 (sandbox harness + fingerprint writer)
- Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-regressions
- Example fingerprint schema: s3://redwood-quant/schemas/fingerprint-v1.json
- Related Linear issues: ENG-31245 (quant calibration harness), ENG-21056 (telemetry fast-fail gate)
acceptance_criteria: 1) Sandbox run command produces a signed fingerprint artifact for sample INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ profiles; 2) Fingerprint uploaded to catalog and visible in Console artifact viewer; 3) Canary sampling can be toggled to 0.5% and telemetry surfaces in the regression dashboard within 10 minutes; 4) Test regression triggers alert and automated rollback path executes to restore previous routing; 5) Documentation (Confluence + API spec) published and linked from the ticket.
updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff meeting with RTE and telemetry. Agreed on hybrid approach: golden-prompt basket (deterministic) + stochastic seed replay (anonymized) for better coverage.

2026-03-05: Spike complete — prototype sandbox harness can run INT8 and GPTQ patches against small LLM runtime image. Early results show P99.9 sensitivity to KV-cache interaction for long prefix prompts.
2026-03-07: Design review feedback from Product (Lara Morales): add rank-stability probe for reranking models and a cost-normalization step to avoid false positives on longer sequences.
2026-03-09: Security review with S&C: confirmed KMS envelope encryption for artifacts and requirement to strip PII before stochastic trace sampling.
2026-03-11: Infra note from Marcus: need a small GPU sandbox pool (2x A10G) and a CI job to run fingerprint smoke on every profile upload. Filed infra ticket ENG-24100.
2026-03-12: Implemented fingerprint schema v1 and pushed initial writer in PR#3456. Next: wire PR to catalog publish endpoint and add canary router flag.
2026-03-13: Canary sampling prototype deployed to staging. Ran synthetic regression test; alert fired and rollback executed successfully in 60s. Preparing demo for PM review next week.

Action items: (1) Finish console toggle for canary and add operator runbook; (2) Implement automated gating rules and manual override UI; (3) Expand golden prompt basket (50 prompts covering long-prefix, code, and rerank samples).
